options_videoFileNameTooltip.message: The name of the downloaded video file will be generated according to the attributes and order in the input box below, separated by spaces.

options_videoCreatorWithAt.message: Add an @ symbol before the video creator's name

options_videoCreatorWithAtTooltip.message: In the downloaded video file name, whether to add the @ symbol before the creator's name.

options_videoDescriptionWithHashtagTip.message: In the downloaded video file names, whether to keep the hashtags starting with # in the video description.

options_videoFileNameEmpty.message: Video file name cannot be empty, please select at least one

options_downloadTipSettingTip.message: When you click the download button, a download prompt will appear in the upper right corner of the window.

options_parseInformationTip.message: In parsing information stage extension will parse all the information needed for downloading.

options_startDownloadTip.message: In start download stage you can see the browser start downloading a file and you can check the download progress on the browser's download page.

options_completeDownloadTip.message: In the download completion stage, the file has been downloaded and you can view the downloaded file in the resource manager.

options_videoQualityTip.message: In what quality to download videos

options_enableSubdirectoryTip.message: Whether to download files to a subdirectory.

snackbar_parseInformationFail.message: Failed to parse the video information, please refresh the page and try again

snackbar_downloadFailed.message: Download failed, please refresh the page and try again

snackbar_findVidError.message: Failed to parse video information, please send an email to feedback the issue

options_fileNameLogicTip.message: Select the logic used to generate the video file name. Only one can be enabled at a time.

options_fileNameLogicPrimaryTip.message: Reads the author, description and tags from page data to build the file name, falling back to DOM elements when needed.

options_fileNameLogicBackupTip.message: Locates the active feed card to read the author and description, for use when the primary logic fails.
